### Yes…You Have the Time
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-december-13-2016.html
Passage: Psalm 118:24
Points:
- Every person receives the exact same allotment of 86,400 seconds each day.
- Every morning brings fresh mercies, making each day a gift to be received.
- God supplies enough time to work, learn, laugh, love, and gracefully accomplish His will.
- Believers are challenged to evaluate how well they steward the gift of today.

### A Hump Day Meditation
Author: Katherine Britton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-nov-11-2009-11616658.html
Passage: Psalm 118:24
Points:
- Dread of weekdays and living purely for the weekend overlooks God's gift of each day.
- Believers face a daily choice between hoarding time as their own or serving God with it.
- Resenting work days reveals a subtle resistance to God's ultimate ownership over our lives.
- Treating time as a stewardship allows believers to rejoice and offer praise continuously.

### Sovereign Grace (Psalm 118)
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/sovereign-grace-psalm-118/
Passage: Psalm 118:22-23
Points:
- Religious leaders tasked with reflecting God's glory ended up rejecting the cornerstone He sent.
- Natural human pride constantly builds monuments to self rather than submitting to God's Messiah.
- God used human opposition and Roman power to display His saving grace through the cross.
- The humiliation and exaltation of Christ is marvelous in the eyes of the redeemed.
- Those saved by sovereign grace are brought into joyful celebration of the Lord's mighty work.

### Why Christians Should Rejoice in the Day the Lord Has Made (Psalm 118)
Author: Aaron D'Anthony Brown
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/why-should-we-rejoice-at-what-the-lord-did-in-psalm-118.html
Passage: Psalm 118:24
Points:
- Psalm 118 grounds persistent rejoicing in God's unchanging and enduring love.
- The day the Lord has made represents both the present moment and the guaranteed day of deliverance.
- Believers can offer thanksgiving in advance because God's salvation is entirely certain.
- Taking refuge in God provides security that human leaders or worldly strength cannot offer.
- Embracing God's steadfast companionship frees believers from fear and prompts daily joy.
